items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: I saw Bob Johnson before he died. Uncle took me to see him in Los Angeles.

ctx.x: We saw quite a few of the California musicians. Like Kidore is out there. Oh, yeah. He's out there. Ed Garland, some of the other members of the band. But I never knew your uncle.
I saw Bob Johnson before he died. Uncle took me to see him in Los Angeles. Got to see him after that. Yes, 1949.
Anyway, I'm sorry that your uncle isn't able to...
